description: This file defines the Time class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing various constructors, methods for parsing and formatting time, and handling platform-specific time representations (Windows and POSIX). It includes functionality for converting between different time formats, comparing times, and retrieving current time.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class encapsulating time representations and conversions, supporting platform-specific implementations and various time formats.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string to initialize the Time object, supporting multiple formats like ISO8601, RFC1123, ANSI, and RFC850.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the Time object to a string representation, defaulting to RFC1123 format.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns the current system time as a Time object.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified number of milliseconds to the current Time object.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts a specified number of milliseconds from the current Time object.
